description: EXIT SECTION (ISO §2023:14.9.14 Format 4 / §2023:14.9.14.4 GR7) — a COBOL-2002 structured-procedure exit transferring control to the end of the current section (firing its PERFORM/SORT/USE return mechanism); introduced 2002.
citation: ISO §2023:14.9.14.2 Format 4 / §2023:14.9.14.4 GR7 — COBOL-2002 structured-exit introduction (VCR has no 85→2002 rows; derived from the 2002 standard)
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. VMEXSEC.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
DRIVER SECTION.
D1.
    PERFORM WORK-SEC.
    STOP RUN.
WORK-SEC SECTION.
W1.
    EXIT SECTION.
W2.
    DISPLAY "W2".
